# Retry Policy

`RetryPolicy` receives structured errors and attempt context. It returns retry/failover decisions and optional delay.

```ts
const rpc = new RpcClient(['https://rpc-a.example.org', 'https://rpc-b.example.org'], {
  retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: fixedBackoff(250) }
})
```

The default policy retries retryable errors and fails over for failoverable errors. It is generic and does not inspect method names.
